userGuide.title: Mobile User Guide
userGuide.intro: Use this page as a quick checklist to get the most out of Smart IoT Kitchen on mobile.

quickStart.title: 1. Quick start
items: Sign in with the account provided by your administrator or self-register and verify your email.
Add your first device from the home screen using the Device ID or by scanning the QR code.
Grant camera, microphone and notification permissions (including lock-screen/overlay) so emergency alerts can break through.

homeDevices.title: 2. Home & devices
items: Monitor online/offline status and last update time inside the Connected Devices card.
Tap “View details” to open sensor data, outlet control and device information.
Pull down to refresh the device list and sync the latest telemetry.

sensorsCharts.title: 3. Sensor charts
items: From any sensor widget, choose “Chart” to open historical data for the current device.
Pick the sensor type, preset range (12h → 30d) or select a custom date window.
Tap any point to inspect its timestamp/value and spot gaps when data was missing.

outletsVoice.title: 4. Outlets & voice control
items: Use the Outlet card to toggle outlets instantly, or tap an outlet to rename and regroup it.
Successful actions automatically refresh the device state so you can confirm the result.
Inside the Chat tab select a device, then send text or voice commands such as “Turn on outlet 1” or “Turn off all outlets”.

rules.title: 5. Automation rules
items: Open the Rules tab and select a device to filter the rule list.
Start from the curated templates (Gas, Smoke, Temperature, …) and customize name, description and priority before saving.
Within rule details you can enable/disable, adjust conditions and cooldown without leaving the screen.

notificationsEmergency.title: 6. Notifications & emergency
items: Use the Notifications screen to review history, mark items as read and refresh the feed.
Visit Settings → Notifications to enable push, email, SMS plus quiet hours or exceptions.
When the emergency overlay appears, review the sensor details and tap “Enable emergency mode” to shut down kitchen devices while powering safety devices.

support.title: 7. Support & troubleshooting
items: Go to Settings → Support → Help & Support to start a conversation with the operations team.
Always include your Device ID, time of incident and screenshots when possible for faster resolution.
If chat cannot be opened, check your network, re-login, or contact your administrator directly via email.
